faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Can't find yours? Ask in the chat itself

items.a: Tap "Try it free" and say hi on WhatsApp. It works on your phone or your computer.

items.q: How does the free trial work?
items.a: With everything in Premium, no card needed. Premium Pro has no trial: it has a 7 day guarantee.

items.q: What happens when the trial ends?
items.a: The diary stops logging until you subscribe. Everything you logged stays saved and comes back in full when you subscribe.

items.q: How do I pay and cancel?
items.a: On the Subscribe page, here on the site, or by replying "subscribe" in the chat, which sends you the link. Monthly is by Pix or card, and by card it renews on its own every month until you cancel. Yearly is by card, in up to 12 interest-free installments, or by Pix upfront, for less. Cancel whenever you like; your access lasts until the end of the period you paid for. Premium Pro is a 12-month program, by card in up to 12 interest-free installments or by Pix upfront, with no renewal. What you pay by Pix does not renew on its own: near the end, the chat sends you the link to renew. Buying Premium Pro cancels your monthly card subscription, and the Premium days you already paid for are discounted from the price.

items.q: What if I change my mind?
items.a: Within 7 days of paying, for Premium or Premium Pro, ask for a refund in the chat and it goes through on its own, in full.

items.q: Who looks after my plan on Premium Pro?
items.a: The assistant. You do a full assessment, and it builds your diet and training from it, with evidence-based methods and reference content. In the check-ins and the monthly reassessment, our team looks at your progress and tells you what changes in the plan and why, or that it stays the same. They also answer your questions, all in the chat and within 24 hours.

No. The assistant is artificial intelligence: it logs, adds up, informs and suggests from reference content, and shows the source when you ask. On Premium, it doesn't prescribe diets or workouts. On Premium Pro, it builds your diet and training from your assessment, and your questions go to our team.

items.q: How does the guided workout work?
items.a: Say "let's start the workout" and the assistant guides you exercise by exercise: it explains the technique, shows the load you used last time and tells you when you can go up. You send each set (reps and load, like "7 80") and get a summary at the end; you can pick the program day, skip a day or turn the guide off.

items.q: Does it work if I use hormones?
items.a: Yes. The app tracks your diet and training either way. Among the ready workout programs, the ones marked natural are science-based and recommended for people who train natural.
It's used for your diary, your plan, billing and support, and handled under Brazil's data protection law (LGPD). We do not sell your data.
